ctx.x: So he said to me, I think you're big enough, he said, he was hitched out in front of the house. He said, I'm going to start in about 10 seconds and if you can ride him around -- tell me where to ride him, if you can ride him in so-and-so time, he's yours. And my mother was in the back and she looked up and here I had him wide open and she said, he's running with Ken, he's running away with Ken. She came running out in the front front lawn.
